headline: 🎉 A SECOND BUYER SAID “INTERESTED” ON 225 WILLOW POINT THIS MORNING — and the question she asked has already been answered in writing. Molly G. texted at 10:27 that her buyers really liked the house, then asked about the ceiling and the closet; your sellers answered those exact two items within the hour, and you sent that answer to the OTHER agent at 11:31. She never got it. ⭐ TWO INTERESTED PARTIES ON ONE HOUSE IN ONE MORNING, neither of whom argued $185,000. ✅ AND THE TASK SYSTEM CAME BACK — this board is reading your live call list again for the first time since Saturday. · DO: call Molly G., her answer is already written · WATCH: the debt draft hits tomorrow.

notes: ✅ THE TASK LIST IS BACK — AND THIS PAGE IS READING IT AGAIN. Ten routines this morning could not write you a single task; that wall is down as of this run, verified by a live read of 96 open rows. ⭐ WHAT THAT MEANS HERE: the call block below is no longer reconstructed from this morning's letters — it is your actual list, in your actual priority order. 🔍 The rows those ten routines could not write are still missing though, so their action items live only in this morning's emails. Nothing was lost, but nothing was filed either.

🔴 THIS STILL READS ALERT BECAUSE THE BLOCKED LINES ARE INSIDE THE 24-HOUR WINDOW — the morning letter, the money pulse, the bookkeeper, the market-report lane and the pipeline forecast all logged BLOCKED against the same disconnected task system. ⭐ The cause is fixed; the record of it is not, and it ages out on its own by tomorrow morning.

🎉 TWO THINGS CLOSED THEMSELVES SINCE THE 10:40 RUN AND BOTH WERE GOOD. The 1709 Fieldstone roof loop is DONE — your coordinator answered the buyer's agent at 9:32 and he replied “all good” at 10:50, so the answer this board called a stranded draft was in fact delivered by a human, on time. 🔥 And 225 Willow Point produced its SECOND interested buyer of the day at 10:27, by text, from the agent who took the very first showing this listing ever had.

callBlock.who: Molly G. — 225 Willow Point buyer's agent
callBlock.why: 🔥 THE FRESHEST AND EASIEST WIN ON THE BOARD. She texted your phone at 10:27 this morning to say her buyers are interested and really liked the house, then asked one question: what happened with the ceiling and the unpatched closet. ⭐ YOU ALREADY HAVE THE ANSWER IN WRITING — your sellers explained both items, and you sent that explanation to a DIFFERENT agent at 11:31. Molly never received it. 🎯 Both concerns are resolved-and-explained rather than defects, which is the strongest answer you can hand a buyer who already likes the house. 📞 Call, do not email — she chose the phone. Then ask what it takes to get her buyers back this week.

callBlock.who: Sondra & Darrell S. — your Willow Point sellers
callBlock.why: 🎉 TWO INTERESTED BUYER PARTIES IN ONE MORNING AND NEITHER ARGUED THE PRICE. That is no longer a feedback update, it is a competitive-position conversation — and it is the exact sell-side momentum their own buy side has been gated on since 8/14. ⭐ THEY EARNED THE CALL: they turned around a written explanation of both buyer concerns inside an hour when you asked. 🔍 Tell them plainly what two interested parties on day six means, and what happens if either comes back for a second look.

callBlock.who: Jeremy P. — the closing attorney on 5167 Lake Crest
callBlock.why: 🔴 DAY FOUR, AND THE BROKERAGE JUST TOLD YOU EXACTLY HOW TO CLEAR IT. Their automated support posted on the file at 1:46: upload proof of payment — a check copy or a wire confirmation — OR simply leave a note saying how the funds are being sent. ⭐ THAT SECOND OPTION NEEDS NO DOCUMENT AND NO ONE ELSE'S COOPERATION, which turns a four-day standoff into a five-minute task. 🎯 The attorney call for the settlement statement is still worth making, but do the note first — it is the cheap half and it unblocks the file today.

callBlock.who: Jay G. — the buyer's agent on 198 Rena
callBlock.why: ⚠️ HE ASKED “ANY WORD?” FRIDAY EVENING AND HAS NOT BEEN ANSWERED SINCE — and the answer is now a good one. Terms came together Sunday evening: agreed number, agreed concessions, both sides at two and a half. 🔴 THE CONTRACT WENT OUT FOR SIGNATURE AT 8:06 THIS MORNING AND NO SIGNATURE RECEIPT HAS APPEARED IN FIVE HOURS. ⭐ A handshake on Sunday with an unsigned document on Monday afternoon is the most fragile state a deal ever occupies; the whole call is get it signed today.

callBlock.who: Angela S. at the title firm — 195 Lake View
callBlock.why: 🔴 FOUR DAYS OF SILENCE ON THREE ITEMS SHE PUT IN WRITING ON 8/20: survey, home warranty, septic and sewer inspection. ⭐ SEPTIC IS THE ONE WITH LEAD TIME — a problem found on the 27th does not close on the 28th, and the table is Friday at 4:00. 🎣 A wire-versus-check question is open on this same file and a fake title company emailed you about wire instructions this morning. ⚠️ Settle the wire question by voice on this call, on a number you already had — never off an email.

callBlock.who: Amy G. — 355 Comanche, the one unqualified YES
callBlock.why: 🔥 THE STRONGEST BUYER READ THIS LISTING HAS EVER PRODUCED IS NOW NINE DAYS OLD. She filed it herself: interested YES, her buyers just started looking, they really like it, and it sits at the TOP of their list. She phoned from inside the house mid-showing, so a call back is returned, not cold. ⭐ SHE LEFT PRICED-RIGHT BLANK — the objection is unasked, not absent, and only a person can ask it. 🔴 The basement lights she reported still have no answer from your seller.

callBlock.who: Zach at McFarlane Homes, and Daniel B. at Deer Ridge
callBlock.why: 🏗️ TWO PEOPLE ARE WAITING AND BOTH ANSWERS ALREADY EXIST. The builder who called off your yard sign is now six days without a callback — and a builder does not buy one lot, he buys a phase. ⚠️ The furthest-along buyer is on day twelve waiting for the perc answer your teammate already found on Friday. 🔍 That is a delegation gap, not a research gap. 📅 The build-and-sell versus vacant-lots thinking you promised the seller was due today, and a draft to him is written and waiting on your send.

callBlock.who: Carlos B., plus Alexis H. and Scott B. — three live hand-raises
callBlock.why: 🆕 THREE PEOPLE RAISED THEIR HANDS AT YOU AND NONE HAS BEEN CALLED. Carlos owns his property, asked you point-blank what it is worth, and has now come back a SECOND time — with a reply drafted and unsent for two days. ⭐ Alexis was on your site at 7:52 this morning and still browsing twenty-nine minutes later in the high six figures. 🔍 Scott answered your check-in himself and asked to talk this week, which is the rarest thing on this list: someone who has already said yes to the call.

listings.status: ⏰ CLOSED AT THE TABLE — frozen, but the exit is now stated
listings.note: 🔴 STILL DAY FOUR WITH THE FILE READING EXPIRED AND PROOF OF PAYMENT REQUIRED — but the brokerage's own support posted the way out at 1:46 today, and it is cheaper than anyone assumed. ⭐ THEY WILL ACCEPT A NOTE: upload a check copy or wire confirmation, OR simply leave a note on the file saying how the funds are being sent. 🎯 THAT TURNS A STANDOFF INTO A FIVE-MINUTE TASK — no document required and nobody else's cooperation needed. 🔍 The settlement statement from the closing attorney is still the durable proof and still worth chasing; it is simply no longer the blocker. ⭐ The milestone engine held this at CLOSING and refused to call it closed, which was right then and is vindicated now.

listings.status: 🎉 AGREED SUN — contract opened 8:06a, still no signature receipt
listings.note: ✅ THE WEEKEND DELIVERED WHAT THIS BOARD CHASED FOR A WEEK: terms agreed Sunday evening in writing, with concessions, both sides at two and a half, and a close date the buyer named. ⚠️ IT LANDED WHILE THE FLEET WAS DARK, so no routine recorded it and no dashboard knew until this morning. 🔴 THE CONTRACT WENT OUT FOR SIGNATURE AT 8:06 THIS MORNING AND NOTHING HAS COME BACK — five hours, no signature receipt on any surface this board can read. ⭐ The buyer's agent also asked for a status Friday evening and still has not been answered, and the answer is now a good one. 🔍 The honest risk is unchanged: these buyers must close their own house first, so this is a contingency, not a closing.

listings.status: ⚠️ CONTINGENT — closes Fri 8/28 at 4 PM, three items open
listings.note: ✅ THE DATE IS SETTLED AND DOES NOT NEED RE-ARGUING: the title firm put Friday the 28th at 4 PM in writing, and the 8/31 the brokerage system prints is a lagging record. 🔴 THREE ITEMS HAVE NOW SAT UNANSWERED FOR FOUR DAYS — survey, home warranty, septic and sewer inspection — and they passed through two morning letters, three midday digests and a deep dive without being named, because nothing in the fleet treats a closer's checklist as its own signal. ⭐ SEPTIC HAS LEAD TIME; the other two do not. 🎯 A wire-versus-check question is also open on this file — settle it by voice.

listings.status: 🔥 ACTIVE — TWO interested parties in one morning, price unchallenged
listings.note: 🎉 THE BEST LISTING STORY YOU OWN RIGHT NOW, AND IT DOUBLED SINCE THIS MORNING. Anna C. returned the first written feedback in this listing's life at 9:47 — buyers really liked it, it showed very well, concerns all cosmetic, and the price went unchallenged when asked directly. 🔥 THEN A SECOND AGENT TEXTED AT 10:27: her buyers are interested too, they really liked it, and she asked about the same ceiling and closet. ⭐ YOUR SELLERS ANSWERED BOTH ITEMS IN WRITING WITHIN THE HOUR, and both are resolved-and-explained rather than defects — but that answer only reached ONE of the two agents. 🎯 Two interested parties on day six, neither arguing $185,000, is a competitive-position conversation with the Stricklands rather than a feedback update. 🔥 Their own buy side toured three houses Sunday as financed buyers; both halves move together.

listings.status: ✅ UNDER CONTRACT — roof loop CLOSED today, closes 10/23
listings.note: 🎉 THIS ONE RESOLVED ITSELF WHILE THE BOARD WAS STILL CALLING IT STUCK. Your coordinator answered the buyer's agent at 9:32 this morning — sellers are double-checking that the listed items fall inside the normal scope of a replacement — and he replied “all good, thank you” at 10:50. ⭐ THE ANSWER THIS PAGE CALLED A STRANDED DRAFT WAS ACTUALLY DELIVERED, by a human, on time. 🔍 The roof scope is settled and any licensed roofer is acceptable, so the contractor question is closed and only the escrow holdback sizing remains. ⚠️ The old unsent draft to that agent is now moot — do not send it on top of a conversation that already ended well.

listings.status: ⚠️ ACTIVE — fifth tour Saturday, still no read
listings.note: 🔍 SATURDAY'S 3:00 PM READ HAS NOW BEEN OUTSTANDING FOR TWO DAYS AND IT IS STILL AN OPEN QUESTION, NOT A NO — but this address returns forms about half the time, so the odds it lands are dropping by the hour. ⚠️ FOUR INDEPENDENT AGENTS HAVE SAID THE SAME THING, and the most recent added the worst staging score on this board, one out of five, plus a lever that is not a price cut: a pre-inspection, because unknowns is precisely what one removes. 🎯 One named live buyer put a specific number under the ask in writing and offered you the representation. ⭐ A weekly report to the asset manager is drafted and waiting on your send.

She filed it herself — interested YES, her buyers just started looking, really like it, and it sits at the TOP of their list — and she phoned from inside the house mid-showing, so a call back is returned, not cold. ⭐ SHE LEFT PRICED RIGHT BLANK: the objection is unasked, not absent. ⚠️ Nine days is past the window where a machine outreach is appropriate, so this is a human call now. 🔴 The basement lights she reported still have no answer, and he is the only man alive who knows why.

listings.status: 🔥 ACTIVE — price cut live, marketing still quoting the dead number
listings.note: ⚠️ THE PRICE CHANGED AND THE INTERNET DID NOT. A live post from 8/20 still says the old number out loud, the publishing tool cannot delete it, and the corrected post could not go out this morning because its scheduled slot had already passed by the time the fleet woke up — it is now re-armed for tomorrow at 7:30. ⭐ THE OBJECTION ON THIS HOUSE IS SQUARE FOOTAGE, NOT THE NUMBER, on both of the passes it took — so another cut buys nothing. 🔍 Its showings have now aged out of the two-week window entirely, which is its own kind of signal.

All three gates are essentially behind it. ⚠️ TWO QUIET ITEMS, BOTH PAPERWORK RATHER THAN CONDITION, AND BOTH NOW OVER A WEEK OLD: the inspection requests have sat with your seller since 8/17, and the title firm still cannot find your seller's name in title, with a third name in play on the same file. ⭐ Neither fixes itself, and a title-vesting problem found in September on a September closing is exactly the kind that moves a date.

🔴 FIVE MONTHS, AND A CLIENT WHO STILL OPENS THE CONVERSATION HIMSELF. He texted with a couple of questions Saturday morning and has now waited two days. ⭐ A MAN WHO HAS WATCHED FIVE MONTHS PASS AND STILL REACHES OUT FIRST IS NOT ANGRY YET — that is the window, and it closes by the hour rather than the week. 🔍 The straight-conversation email is drafted and waiting on your send; day 157 has earned the honest version, not another update.

🔴 THE MOST EXPENSIVE LISTING IN THE BOOK AND NOT ONE TOUR HAS EVER BEEN BOOKED ON IT. ⭐ THE WEEKEND SHARPENED THE POINT RATHER THAN SOFTENING IT: a $185,000 listing pulled three tours in twenty-one hours off the same marketing machine that has never produced a single booking here. 🔍 The comp work says the big-house ceiling in that zip is roughly $950K unless acreage carries it — which makes the silence a pricing answer, not a marketing one. The day-32 conversation is drafted and waiting.

⭐ THE WEEKEND IS THE ARGUMENT FOR PRE-BOOKING IT. Willow Point ran paid ads for three days before anyone toured it, then took three tours in twenty-one hours once the market found it. 🔍 The gap that costs money is between photos ready and booked — six days wide on this one, and entirely inside your control. ⚠️ A second coming-soon address surfaced last week with nothing behind it at all — no listing number, no price, no folder, no media — and that one is a real hole, not a scheduling question.

pipeline.paceProjection: ⚠️ 22 CLOSED YTD ANNUALISES TO ABOUT 34 AGAINST A GOAL OF 45 — the seventh consecutive day under the survive line, and roughly seven closings behind where the calendar says you should be. ⭐ THE NEXT NUMBER IS NO LONGER STUCK BEHIND A MYSTERY: the deal that would make it 23 is flagged EXPIRED at the brokerage, and their own support stated today that a note describing how the funds are being sent may clear it — so the largest expected payout of the month is one short message from moving. 🎯 THIS MORNING'S FORECAST CUT THE BOARD HONESTLY: nine raw opportunities weight down to under five expected, and Sunday's agreement on 198 Rena moved that one file's odds up by more than half on its own. 🔍 Behind it, 195 Lake View on 8/28 and 3350 Altamont on 9/14 sit inside the window; 1709 Fieldstone on 10/23 does not, though its roof contingency cleared today. Team pace sits at 35 against 90.

money.note: 🔴 TOMORROW IS THE DATE AND IT IS ALREADY SET. A debt-settlement draft is scheduled for Tuesday against a balance that cannot cover it — you authorised it yourself on Saturday, which was the right instinct, but the FULL installment was scheduled instead of the smaller amount the creditor had already offered in writing. ⭐ THE SECOND FAILED DRAW IS THE ONE THAT VOIDS THE SETTLEMENTS, so this is a phone call today, not a payment. ⚙️ AND THERE IS A TODAY DEADLINE, NOT A TOMORROW ONE: the brokerage share consolidation completes at 4:01 Eastern this afternoon — the multiplier in the money app must not change until the new ticker is live, or that page prints roughly ten times the truth. 🎣 THIS MORNING'S WIRE-FRAUD LURE STANDS: a fake title company emailed closing instructions four days before a real closing, while a genuine wire-versus-check question sits open on that very file. It names a firm that appears on none of your files and does not address you by name. ⭐ CONFIRM EVERY WIRE BY VOICE ON A NUMBER YOU ALREADY HAD. 🔴 The commission on the deal that closed Thursday is still frozen, though the brokerage has now stated a note alone may clear it. 📚 The books drift guard has tripped ten days running; no summary number from that system is quotable until one bank rule is fixed. ⚠️ Balances, amounts and account details are deliberately withheld — this page is public.

isa.decayPolicy: ✅ THIS NUMBER IS LIVE AND VERIFIED FOR THE FIRST TIME TODAY — 96 open rows, read straight from the task system this run after ten routines were locked out of it all morning. The 93 this page showed earlier was Saturday's stale read, and it was three light. 🔴 NINETY-TWO OF THE NINETY-SIX ARE DUE OR OVERDUE, and twenty-six of those carry top priority. ⭐ THE USEFUL DISTINCTION WAS NEVER AGE, IT IS DIRECTION: roughly a third are people actively waiting on YOU — a returned call, an answered question, a promise in your own words. Those cost relationships. The rest are prospects to chase, and they only cost opportunities. 🎉 THE STRONGEST ARGUMENT FOR WORKING THE LIST WAS MADE THIS MONTH: the listing you won came off a row that was overdue eighteen days. 🔥 The freshest rows are still sellers — homeowners disputing your own valuation upward on their own houses, which is the most reliable listing signal your site produces. 🔴 The contactless problem remains structural: fourteen address-only home-value records in nine days with no name, email or phone on any of them, and two root-cause theories already proven wrong. That one needs a ruling from you, not another investigation.
isa.sweepCadence: every 30 minutes while the fleet is up — and it has been up continuously since 8:24 this morning, after an eighteen-and-a-half-hour hole running from Sunday afternoon, the fourth outage in about ten days. ✅ THE RECOVERY WAS THE BEST WORK OF THE DAY: the first sweep back sent seven first touches in one pass and later passes carried it past twenty, and every one of them was found by querying the inbox by sender — because the instant-lead webhook, the lane that is supposed to catch them, returned empty on all of them. ⭐ THAT IS THE FINDING THAT MATTERS: the alerting artery kept firing all weekend while the working artery was stopped, so alerts alone never proved the machine was running. 🔍 The ownership guard held throughout and correctly left a teammate's lead untouched. ⚠️ About one in eight of today's first touches hard-bounced — those are phone-only from here.
